reasoning_trace.value: The paper proposes a joint communication and sensing (JCAS) waveform design method for pulse amplitude modulation (PAM) signal based on visible light. The system model consists of a light source (e.g., LED) transmitting an integrated optical signal for both communication and sensing. The signal is received by a communication detector and a sensing detector. The paper analyzes the effects of the integrated waveform parameter on common communication and sensing metrics and proposes an optimization framework for the integrated waveform parameter to achieve a tradeoff between communication and sensing performance under peak power constraint.
